rows.grounds: āpāditadvijatvasya = of-one given twice-born-status; genitive singular of compound āpādita-dvijatva
dvādaśānte = at-the twelve-end; locative singular of dvādaśānta (dvādaśa + anta)
nijaikyataḥ = from-union with-one's-own-self; ablative adverb formed from nija-aikya + -tas
sparśamātrānna = not merely-from-touch; compound of sparśa-mātra (abl.sg.) and negative particle na
viśrāntyā = by-resting; instrumental singular of viśrānti
jhaṭityevāvarohataḥ = suddenly descending; sandhi of jhaṭiti (indecl.), eva (indecl.), and avarohataḥ (gen.sg. of present participle avarohat, √ruh with ava-)
